Introducing oc-box 📦

Give OpenCode its own persistent Linux development environment—without installing every project dependency on your host.

oc-box runs unmodified OpenCode inside rootless Podman workspaces, with:

• Persistent tools, project environments and conversation history.
• MCP servers, formatters and plugins running alongside OpenCode.
• Seven Linux distro options, from Ubuntu and Debian to Fedora, Arch, Alpine and openSUSE.
• An optional encrypted credential vault and full/portable workspace backups.
• CPU, memory and process limits, plus explicit GPU/NPU device access when needed.
• Native conversation UI, browser access and a persistent session terminal for supported OpenCode versions.

Two release channels, one project:

✅ Stable — the default channel for published stable releases.
🧪 Devel — opt-in prereleases for trying new features and providing feedback. Experimental does not mean stable.

Current stable: 1.6.94. Install from GitHub or PyPI, with pipx and uv supported for isolated CLI installations.

Source, installation and documentation:
https://github.com/groopcd/oc-box

Rootless containers share the host kernel, and the mounted project remains writable.

#OpenSource #Linux #OpenCode #Podman #DeveloperTools
